review.note: Retracted in M22: a robbery of a Banco Pinto & Sottomayor branch at Soure on 8 February 1977 by the PRP-BR. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.
